issues.description: Adding `setuptools<82` as a runtime install dependency leaks a CI workaround into end-user installs
issues.detail: core/setup.py adds `setuptools<82` to the `raytune` extras list. setuptools is a build/install tool, not a runtime dep; pinning it for all users to work around an mmcv/mmengine CI bug forces downgrades on consumers who don't use mmcv. The cap belongs in the CI scripts (already present) — not in published package metadata.

issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without justification or compatibility check
issues.detail: setup_mmcv.sh changes mmdet from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 alongside an mmengine swap. The PR description is empty and there is no note explaining the bump or confirming it remains compatible with the downstream multimodal code paths. If 3.3.0 was just convenient, document why; otherwise keep 3.2.0 to minimize regression surface.

issues.description: `--no-build-isolation` for mmcv requires build deps already present in env
issues.detail: Installing `mmcv==2.1.0 --no-build-isolation` means pip will use whatever setuptools/wheel/torch are already installed in the env. The script pins setuptools<82 just before, but does not ensure torch, ninja, or other mmcv build prerequisites are present. If the surrounding job ordering changes, this becomes a silent build failure. Worth a comment documenting the assumed pre-state.

issues.description: Order of installs is fragile: mmcv installed before mmengine despite mmcv depending on mmengine
issues.detail: mmcv 2.x lists mmengine as a runtime dep. Installing mmcv first with --no-build-isolation may pull or resolve mmengine implicitly via pip, then the explicit `mmengine==0.10.7` install overwrites it. Reversing the order (mmengine then mmcv) is closer to the documented OpenMMLab install order and avoids any chance of version churn mid-install.

issues.description: FIXME comments lack tracking owner/date for the setuptools<82 cap removal
issues.detail: Three locations now pin setuptools<82 as a temporary workaround referencing mmcv issue 3325. There is no owner, no review date, and the cap in core/setup.py has no FIXME at all. When upstream fixes the issue, this cap will likely linger. Add a TODO with a date and link in setup.py so it's not forgotten in a release.

review.summary: This PR works around an mmcv/setuptools-82 incompatibility by capping setuptools and switching to PyPI mmengine. The main concern is that the setuptools<82 cap was added to core/setup.py's raytune extras, which leaks a CI-only workaround into the published package and will constrain end users. The undocumented mmdet bump from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 also deserves justification. The CI script changes themselves are reasonable but install order and --no-build-isolation prerequisites should be documented.
